blocks.where: bullets.0.concepts.2 (General Purpose vs Provisioned IOPS SSD)
blocks.issue: Use-case lists and 'Sustained IOPS performance' / I/O-intensive databases / io2 Block Express under 500 microseconds are on the EBS volume-types page; the 'sustained IOPS' phrase is not in the block's quotes (it is on the page).
blocks.suggestedFix: Optional: add quote 'Workloads that require sustained IOPS performance or more than 16,000 IOPS'.

blocks.issue: 'you do not need to over-provision up front: start at the size you need and grow it, because you can increase a volume's size but cannot decrease it' - this is a design inference not stated by the page, and 'cannot decrease' is a reason against over-provisioning only by the note's own reasoning. Facts (increase size, change type, adjust performance, no detaching, can't decrease, no charge to modify, charged for new configuration) are quoted.
blocks.suggestedFix: State the facts and label the advice: 'Elastic Volumes can increase the size, change the type or adjust the performance of a volume, without detaching it if the instance supports it. You can't decrease the volume size. As study guidance, that is why you grow a volume as needed instead of over-provisioning up front.'

blocks.issue: 'RDS starts the modification only when free space is low (at or below a threshold) and the low-storage condition lasts at least five minutes' - the page lists a third required factor: 'Storage optimization has completed on the instance for the previous storage modification, and fewer than four storage modifications have occurred in the past 24 hours.' 'Only when ... and' presents two conditions as complete.
blocks.suggestedFix: 'RDS starts a storage modification for an autoscaling-enabled DB instance when free space is at or below a threshold, the low-storage condition lasts at least five minutes, and the previous storage optimization has completed (with limits on modifications per day); you set the maximum storage threshold.' and add the third-factor quote.

blocks.issue: Learn table shows Premium SSD v2 (gp3 row) and Ultra Disk (io2 row) with OS-disk 'No'; EBS HDD table lists 'Boot volume Not supported' for st1 and sc1; Learn has no st1/sc1/HDD row.
